fruit_description: Large, smooth, pale green oval leaves with greenish-white midribs
flavor_profile: Best-flavored American variety for cooked greens - rich mustard taste
disease_resistance: Slower to bolt than other varieties
special_characteristics: Considered by many as the best-flavored American mustard variety. Fast-growing with abundance of flavorful large leaves. Grows to about 10 inches in height. Extremely popular in southern-style cuisine. Slower to bolt than most varieties.
